contentList.content: When you damage a creature with a proficient Handaxe, Rapier, Shortsword, Shortbow, or Hand Crossbow, you gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on your next attack against that creature before the end of your next turn.
The creature that applied Vex has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on its next attack against this target.

When you hit with a proficient Mace, Spear, Flail, Longsword, Morningstar, or War Pick, the target has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
Has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on its next attack roll.

When you deal damage with a proficient Club, Javelin, Light Crossbow, or Longbow, reduce the target's movement speed by 3 m until the start of your next turn. Additional Slow effects do not increase this reduction.
Movement speed is reduced by 3 m.

When you hit with a proficient Quarterstaff, Battleaxe, Maul, or Trident, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or fall <LSTag Tooltip="Prone">Prone</LSTag>. The save DC is 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + the ability modifier used for the attack.

When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a proficient Greatclub, Pike, Warhammer, or Heavy Crossbow, push it up to 3 m directly away from you. Toggle this mastery off when you do not want to move your target.
